card.line: The King's Highway was a main road that Israel asked Edom and King Sihon of the Amorites for permission to travel along as they passed through their lands.

moments.title: Edom Says No
moments.text: Israel asked to pass through Edom's land and promised to stay on the King's Highway and pay for any water. Edom refused and came out with a large army, so Israel turned away.

moments.title: Sihon Says No
moments.text: Israel asked King Sihon of the Amorites to let them pass through his land, promising to stay on the King's Highway. Sihon refused and fought Israel, and Israel took his land and cities, including Heshbon.
